messages.content: How do I check in to the fictional Bramble Inn in this demo?
I made up these demo steps for the fictional Bramble Inn: first, greet the innkeeper at the front desk; second, sign the guest ledger; third, take the brass key for room 3.

note: Fictional demo record. Every name, place, and step is invented for documentation; judging it exercises the evaluator without any real Arena content.
